caption: “Distribution in North America of rabbits of the genus Sylvilagus,” from E. W. Nelson, North American Fauna, No. 29: The Rabbits of North America (Washington, DC: Government Printing Office, 1909), p. 43.
alt: A map of North and Central America with the range of the cottontail rabbits shaded across nearly all of the United States, Mexico and Central America, stopping short of Canada.
bibliography: Nelson, E. W. "Distribution in North America of Rabbits of the Genus Sylvilagus." The Rabbits of North America, North American Fauna 29, Government Printing Office, 1909.
